name: Consequent encroachment / half gap (ORG)

definitions.definition_text: Probabilities framed as always trading back down to consequent encroachment of the RTH opening range gap; also stated: half of the gap that forms at opening bell at 9:30 — if there is one — chances are 70% of the time it makes an attempt to trade to half gap. It doesn't have to trade to half gap.
conditions: Attempt toward half gap / CE (not necessarily full fill)
invalidation: Explicit: does not have to reach half gap
definitions.timeframe_session_context: Around 9:30 open / first 30 minutes emphasis elsewhere in same lecture
definitions.variations_note: Same video repeats ~70% CE/half-gap likelihood near 55:03 — keep as reinforcing occurrence rather than merging stats.

definitions.definition_text: Opening range gap: 70% likelihood is going to go to half gap or consequent encroachment.
definitions.timeframe_session_context: ORG discussion / first 30 minutes drills framing
definitions.variations_note: Same lecture restatement of 70% CE/half-gap claim — retained separately for citation fidelity.

definitions.definition_text: Between 9:31 and 10:00 Eastern, always anticipate the likelihood — 70% likelihood — that it's going to try to get to the midpoint of that opening range gap.
definitions.variations_note: KEEP SEPARATE: window starts at 9:31 here vs 9:30 in other occurrences — do not collapse clocks.

definitions.definition_text: In premium gaps, first 30 minutes: aim for the half gap; best-case scenario would be 3/4 gap.
definitions.variations_note: Ladder beyond CE (3/4) — separate from the 70% CE attempt claim.

definitions.definition_text: After running buy side (e.g. overnight/London high or REH between 6:00–9:30), look for price to trade back down into minimum consequent encroachment — the middle of the gap. Whether to seek complete gap closure depends on bullish/bearish stance or if just trading inside a range. Premium-gap rules reverse for a discount ORG.
conditions: Initial buy-side run then seek CE mid-gap
invalidation: Complete gap closure not required — minimum objective is CE
definitions.timeframe_session_context: Post-open delivery into ORG mid-gap; 2025 model framing
definitions.variations_note: Minimum CE objective without 70% frequency claim — KEEP SEPARATE from eft9/6Du 70% rows.

definitions.definition_text: Example path through previous day premium ORG: breaks lower → upper quadrant → consequent encroachment → lower quadrant → complete closure of the previous day premium opening range gap.
conditions: Prior-day premium ORG levels still relevant
definitions.variations_note: Ladder sequence (UQ→CE→LQ→full fill) — separate from 3/4-gap premium first-30m ladder in eft9.

definitions.definition_text: On premium ORG (Fib from 4:14 close up to 9:30 open): as market sells off, consequent encroachment / mid-gap offers shorting opportunity; bodies shown respecting the midpoint, then lower quadrant / low of gap.
definitions.timeframe_session_context: Intraday delivery into graded premium ORG
definitions.variations_note: CE as actionable mid-gap with body respect — no frequency % here.

source.title: 2025 Lecture Series - SMC Opening Range Gaps

definitions.definition_text: For any gap (including ORG): the midpoint is consequent encroachment. For order blocks / breaker / propulsion blocks, the midpoint is mean threshold (50% of that range) — two different viewpoints of a midpoint (gap/wick → CE; other order block → mean threshold).
conditions: Gap or wick → CE at midpoint
Order block family → mean threshold at midpoint
definitions.timeframe_session_context: General PD-array midpoint taxonomy adjacent to ORG definition
definitions.variations_note: KEEP SEPARATE from ORG-only CE rows; also ASR auto-caption says encouragement — meaning is encroachment.

conditions: PD array / FVG aligning to ORG CE or quadrant

definitions.variations_note: CE as magnet/alignment for other inefficiencies — not a 70% frequency claim.
